si3_author_journal_year: Heyuan Jia et al., Scientific Reports, 2025
si4_title: Cortical thickness deviations as biomarker for subtyping and prognosis in pediatric brainstem tumors

dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Data from 849 healthy children were sourced from: (i) 61 locally recruited in Beijing (SINGLE-SITE); (ii) 69 from the fcon_1000 projects dataset (FCON); (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP); (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center (SINGLE-SITE). Patient data (N=145) were studied at Beijing Tiantan Hospital (SINGLE-SITE).
dc1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: To create a normative model, data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four databases: (i) 61 were locally recruited in Beijing; (ii) 69 from the fcon_1000 projects dataset; (iii) 450 from the Child Connectome Project (devCCNP) 27 ; (iv) 269 from the Guangzhou Women and Children's Medical Center. ... A cohort of 145 pediatric patients with brainstem tumors was studied at Beijing Tiantan Hospital...

answer.SINGLE-SITE: normative training and validation (Beijing and Guangzhou cohorts); patient for clinical research (Beijing Tiantan Hospital)

dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: Healthy control datasets (devCCNP, FCON, and two Single-Sites) were used to establish the normative CTh model using GPR and 10-fold cross-validation. The patient dataset from Beijing Tiantan Hospital was used for clinical subtyping and prognostic analysis based on CTh deviations.
dc2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: To create a normative model, data from 849 healthy children were sourced from four databases... We validated the models through 10-fold cross-validation on the healthy control dataset before finalizing the normative models. After that, these models were used to predict CTh for each participant and assess any deviations.

dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.detail: The normative model for cortical thickness (CTh) was built using 849 healthy controls. The training phase N for the final model is not explicitly stated, but 10-fold cross-validation was employed during the model development process.
dc3_healthy_control_number_of_each_norma.supporting_text: the final analysis included 145 patients and 849 healthy children. ... We validated the models through 10-fold cross-validation on the healthy control dataset before finalizing the normative models.
